name: birds-eye
prompt: Edit the supplied Stonehenge museum miniature. Preserve realistic weathered grey sarsen stone materials, lichen, present-day ruined arrangement (not a reconstructed complete ring), irregular lintels and uprights, and inner/fallen stones. Change camera elevation only; show the full stone group, on transparent background with no ground, grass, pedestal, cast shadow, labels or scenery. Lighting must come from screen northwest/upper left, darker right faces. Orthographic-like long lens, restrained perspective, detailed photoreal miniature, 6% clear margins. Bird's-eye view looking down at about 65 degrees from horizontal. Reveal the circular layout and inner horseshoe of remaining trilithons, gaps and fallen stones, while still seeing some upright faces. Present-day ruins, not a complete idealized prehistoric reconstruction. No circular ground disk; gaps are transparent.
